tagline.zh: 看看你们之间发生了什么
tagline.en: See what's really going on between you two

description.zh: 你此刻在这段关系中的心境与立场。
description.en: Where your heart and stance stand right now.

description.zh: 对方的想法、感受与态度。
description.en: The other person's thoughts, feelings, and attitude.

description.zh: 你们之间的互动状态与可能的走向。
description.en: The dynamic between you and where it may be heading.

tagline.en: Get clarity on your work situation

description.zh: 当前事业/工作上的真实处境。
description.en: Where things really stand at work right now.

description.zh: 需要正视并克服的主要障碍。
description.en: The main obstacle you need to face and overcome.

description.zh: 接下来值得采取的行动方向。
description.en: A direction worth taking from here.

tagline.en: Check which way the wind blows for your wallet

description.zh: 你目前的财务状况与金钱心态。
description.en: Your current financial situation and money mindset.

description.zh: 潜在的收入来源或财富机会。
description.en: A potential source of income or opportunity for growth.

description.zh: 在财务上值得采取的行动。
description.en: What's worth doing next with your money.

tagline.zh: 感受时间脉络中的能量流动
tagline.en: Feel the flow of energy across time

description.zh: 带你走到今天的过往影响。
description.en: The past influences that brought you here.

description.zh: 当下围绕着你的能量与状态。
description.en: The energy and state surrounding you now.

tagline.zh: 写下你心里真正想问的事
tagline.en: Ask whatever is actually on your mind

description.zh: 围绕这个问题，当下的真实处境。
description.en: Where this question actually stands right now.

description.zh: 正在推动或阻碍事情发展的力量。
description.en: The force pushing this along — or holding it back.

description.zh: 针对这个问题值得采取的方向。
description.en: The direction worth taking on this.
